scenes.text: You stayed silent. So he dug.
For weeks, a family's been trying to reach you. Last night, their kid found your secret vent.
All night. With a beach shovel.
You built me that swing. Remember?
This was never your backyard. It's your daughter's. You moved in two years ago.
The banging? They were begging you to come inside.
The tunnel? The only way to reach you, without breaking the hatch you'd bolted.
Dad. A big storm is coming tonight. Rain will flood your vent, so we have to cover it. Please, open the hatch, or no air till it passes. We're right here.
They weren't guarding your vent. They were listening, to make sure you were still breathing.
The alert went off once. Over forty years ago. But some nights, for you, it never stopped.
Dad? It's me. Let's go inside.
Thank you for watching. Which series should we make next? Comment one, two, or three.
